from pathlib import Path
import sys, os, json, hashlib, shutil, zipfile, time

repo=Path('/workspace/AI-radio-stream-help')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts'))
from app_update import execute

base=repo/'.build/desktop/character-windows312-x64'
work=repo/'.build/packaged-app-update-smoke'
if work.exists():raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite previous smoke evidence')
work.mkdir()
target=work/'target';folder=work/'update'
archive=Path('/workspace/dist/companion-update-0.5.0-dev2-ui2d.zip')
started=time.monotonic()
def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open('rb') as source:
  while block:=source.read(1024*1024):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()

critical=[Path('resources/backend/app/server.py'),Path('resources/backend/runtime-profile-manifest.json'),
 Path('resources/backend-profiles/cuda/app/server.py'),Path('resources/backend-profiles/cuda/runtime-profile-manifest.json'),Path('resources/app/main.cjs'),Path('BUILD-INFO.json')]
before={str(p):sha(base/p) for p in critical}
shutil.copytree(base,target,copy_function=os.link)
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
 for name in bundle.namelist():
  p=Path(name)
  if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or '\\' in name:raise ValueError('Unsafe archive member')
 bundle.extractall(folder)
sentinel=target/'local-user-data-sentinel.txt'
sentinel.write_text('SYNTHETIC_USER_DATA_MUST_REMAIN_UNCHANGED')
native=next((target/'resources/backend').rglob('llama.dll'))
native_sha=sha(native)
checks={}
one=execute(target,folder);assert one['status']=='applied';checks['actual_74_operation_package_apply']=True
m=json.loads((folder/'app-update-manifest.json').read_text())
for name in ['resources/backend','resources/backend-profiles/cuda']:
 p=json.loads((target/name/'runtime-profile-manifest.json').read_text())
 assert p['source_id']==m['new_source_id']
 assert (target/name/'app/server.py').read_bytes()==(repo/'app/server.py').read_bytes()
checks['cpu_and_cuda_actual_sources_and_source_ids_match']=True
assert execute(target,folder)['status']=='already_applied';checks['repeat_is_idempotent']=True
assert execute(target,folder,rollback=True)['status']=='rolled_back'
assert {str(p):sha(target/p) for p in critical}==before;checks['rollback_restores_original_metadata_host_and_sources']=True
assert execute(target,folder)['status']=='applied';checks['reapply_after_rollback']=True
assert sha(native)==native_sha;checks['native_library_unchanged']=True
assert sentinel.read_text()=='SYNTHETIC_USER_DATA_MUST_REMAIN_UNCHANGED';checks['synthetic_user_data_unchanged']=True
assert {str(p):sha(base/p) for p in critical}==before;checks['hardlinked_original_base_unmodified']=True
report={'passed':True,'checks':checks,'source_commit':m['new_source_commit'],'archive_sha256':sha(archive),
 'operations':len(m['files']),'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),
 'scope':'Real published-base files and exact final update package; Linux hardlink fixture; no Windows executable or DLL was run.',
 'windows_application_verified':False,'reproduce_script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)), 'reproduce_script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(repo/'review/packaged-app-update-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='reproduce_script'}))
